title: Direct payment versus escrow decision table
question: Should this agentic purchase use direct payment or escrow?

decisionTable.rationale: Conditional settlement adds no counterparty protection when nothing remains to verify after settlement.

when: evidence review, dispute, deadline, or refund may be needed
amount or counterparty risk is meaningful
decisionTable.rationale: Escrow preserves commitment while release stays conditional on evidence, approval, or dispute paths.

when: a cheap access or quote fee is due now
a larger protected principal depends on later outcome
decisionTable.rationale: RFC 0003 treats the rails as complementary. A full shared-ID composition has not been demonstrated yet.
decisionTable.openGap: shared correlation identifiers and receipts across access payment, escrow, fulfillment, and recovery

secondAxis.note: Escrow does not automatically solve facilitator or dependency failures.
